svg.text: Abaqus/Standard & SIMULIA Industrial Finite Element Data Pipeline • Subroutine USDFLD

g.text: STAGE 1: STEPPED SHAFT CAD & USDFLD GRADIENT
• Total length L = 294.1 mm | Central journal Ø38 mm | Gear Ø68.2 mm
• Cross-drilled lubrication channels (Ø3.5 & Ø8 mm) and longitudinal splines
• Full 3D quadratic tetra mesh eliminating geometric slicing bottlenecks
• Internal hydrostatic DOF in C3D10M prevents volumetric locking (nu → 0.5)
• Consistent contact force weighting prevents punch contact chattering
• Surface inflation layer: 3 to 4 elements through 0.6 mm case depth
• Retrieves integration point coordinates COORD via CALL GETVRM
• Evaluates piecewise outer radius: Router(z) along stepped shaft
• Computes radial depth: d(r, z) = Router(z) - sqrt((x-x0)^2 + (y-y0)^2)
• Maps depth d directly to Field Variable 1: FIELD(1) = d(r, z)
• Tracks equivalent plastic strain (PEEQ) history in STATEV(2)
• Exports radial case depth in STATEV(1) for ODB field visualization
• -350 to -500 MPa case compression balanced by +150 to +250 MPa core tension
• 3-2-1 isostatic restraints dissipate residual forces prior to tool contact
• Imposed downward vertical stroke Uy(t) on punch Reference Point (R = 20 mm)
• Preserves diagonal dominance in tangent matrix KT near plastic limit load
• Surface-to-surface penalty contact with Coulomb friction (mu = 0.10)
• UNSYMM=YES resolves non-symmetric stiffness matrix from frictional sliding
• Punch retraction until normal contact force vanishes identically (CNORMF = 0)
• Chaboche kinematic backstress captures reverse yielding (Bauschinger effect)
• Prevents 30–45% springback overestimation seen in isotropic models
• Centerline extraction: TIR = max(Uy(z)) - min(Uy(z)) < 20–30 µm tolerance
Interpolates: ~60 HRC (σy = 1900 MPa) at case surface → ~30 HRC (σy = 750 MPa) in core
STAGE 3: SIMULATION RESULTS, INDUSTRIAL VERIFICATION & AUTOMATED REPORTING
• Evaluated on outer convex case fiber

svg.text: • FEA Solver: Abaqus/Standard 2023x • Subroutine: USDFLD (Fortran 2008 / F90) • Benchmark CAD: arvore_secundaria_husson.step (L = 294.1 mm)
